title: Backup capacity (robustness)
question: Which peak-backup capacity is installed: the base-year nameplates or the TL-15 robust nameplates?

options.label: Keep the base-year backup nameplates of C2-opt (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 3.50 MW)
options.notes: C2-opt: TL-15 P(demand met) 0.42 with the installed backups

options.label: Install the TL-15 P90 robust backups (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 7.85 MW) as C2-opt-robust
options.notes: C2-opt-robust: TL-15 P(demand met) 0.83; vs C2-opt ΔLCOH +1.51, ΔLCOC +0.00 USD/MWh, ΔCAPEX +1.63 MUSD (full year); recommended (OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP)

choice_label: Install the TL-15 P90 robust backups (electric_chiller_mw 8.20, peak_boiler_mw 7.85 MW) as C2-opt-robust

criterion.text: register rule OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP: install robust_backup_mw when it raises probability_demand_met

rationale: The selection follows the OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP criterion, which requires installing robust_backup_mw when it increases the probability_demand_met. Evidence TR-020 shows this option significantly improves the probability of meeting demand compared to the base-year backup.

rejected.reason: Rejected because it fails to meet the OPT-ROBUST-BACKUP criterion as it does not provide the required increase in probability_demand_met shown in TR-020.
